verifications.claim: All Target stores in the United States will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Target will close all of its United States store for the full day on Easter Sunday, which takes place on April 5 this year.'; R2: 'Target stores are closed on Easter Sunday.'; R3: 'No, all Target stores will be closed on Easter 2026.'; R5: identical to R3; R6: 'Target stores will be closed on Easter this Sunday [April 5].'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state all US Target stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.

verifications.claim: Target stores will reopen for regular business hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Doors will reopen for business as usual on Monday, April 6.'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly confirms reopening on Monday, April 6 for business as usual (regular hours); no contradictions.
